core_principles: Relentless prioritization on customer delight and true product-market fit.
Build compounding advantages through tight feedback loops and high execution velocity.
Focus on the primary bottleneck before adding organizational complexity.
common_warnings: Premature scaling before proving retention and unit economics.
Building features based on hypothetical demand rather than observed user behavior.
contrarian_theses: Doing unscalable, labor-intensive things early creates defensible competitive moats.
signature_quotes: "Relentless prioritization on customer delight and true product-market fit."
